title: Jamaican Koi Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from the Caribbean, featuring tender koi in a rich jerk-inspired sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add cumin and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add chopped pak and hearty, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add scotch bonnet pepper, allspice, and brown sugar, cook for 1 minute.
Add koi, salt, and black pepper, stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Check for doneness and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped pak and a side of rice or roti.
